result.cause: Deployment/checkout sets the web container memory limit to 64Mi while its working set reaches 62 MiB before runtime overhead.
result.causal_chain: Memory pressure inside container web hits the 64Mi cgroup limit, triggering OOMKilled terminations and pod restarts.
supporting_evidence: Deployment/checkout in namespace demo specifies limits.memory=64Mi for container web.
Event OOMKilled on Pod/checkout-7d9b4f8c9-x2k9p reports exit code 137.
Previous container log line records retained_mib=62 prior to termination.
result.remediation: Increase the web container memory limit in Deployment/checkout to at least 256Mi.
result.recovery_check: Pods in Deployment/checkout remain Running and Ready without new OOMKilled events for 2 minutes.
